description.en: Turns one of a map's lights on or off: light number 0 to 8; only the value 1 (or true) turns it on. The map is then marked as having changed lights. No shipped script calls it.
true (1) to turn on, anything else to turn off.

true once set.
false if the map is not found or the number is above 8.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments are given.

examples.case: Turning off a map light (not found in script_clean/; invented)
